items.title: How Taiwan’s military manpower shortage is undermining its ability to fight
items.original_title: How Taiwan’s military manpower shortage is undermining its ability to fight
items.rss_summary:
Taiwan’s military is grappling with a worsening manpower shortage, with its volunteer staffing rate remaining below the 80 per cent target for a third consecutive year and concerns mounting over the impact on combat readiness, according to the island’s legislature.
The shortages extend deep into frontline formations – including infantry, artillery, missile and air defence units – raising questions over whether Taiwan will have enough trained personnel to operate and maintain the vast quantities.
